messages:
ashley: Planning a BYOK tabletop tomorrow 09:00 PT. Scope: RBAC JIT issuance, audit logging, and rewrap fallback in staging only. No prod HSM. Please include oncall, ops, legal.

kevin: Acknowledged. Will we simulate key import or replay an actual customer BYOK flow with synthetic material?

ashley: We'll replay the flow with synthetic keys in staging HSM. Aim: verify entitlement issuance, operator handoff, and rewrap. Runbook (draft): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/key-custody-tabletop

maria: Audit requirements: ensure actor_email, actor_role, admin_session_id, mfa_present are in every KMS/HSM event. We need ability to produce log digests for SOC2.

ashley: Staging retention is 90d. We'll emit those fields and compute a SHA256 digest of the exported logs after the drill.

tony: I'll create a JIT role. What exact permissions? Least privilege please.

ashley: Role: drill_byo_operator. Scope: staging key ARNs only. Allow: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:DescribeKey. Deny: any production ARNs and kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. Conditions: aws:SourceVpc == staging-vpc AND aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent == true. TTL 45m.

kevin: Logging query for extraction:

```
resource.type="kms_key" AND jsonPayload.action:("ReEncrypt" "GenerateDataKey")
| parse jsonPayload.actor_email as actor
| sort timestamp desc
```

maria: On vuln triage: vendor advisory CVE-2026-1111 affects older staging firmware. Low exploitability remote, but we'll not upgrade during drill. Simulate operator compromise instead.

ashley: Drill will revoke JIT entitlements mid-run and trigger rewrap-only fallback. Measure detection-to-rewrap latency.

sec-bot: :warning: Runbook missing steps: "notify-legal" and "archive-audit-digest". Update before execution.

oncall-night: I will handle handoff. Propose pre-creating an emergency unseal token in Vault requiring 2 approvals; log unseal ops. I'll shadow the operator.

tony: I'll push the IAM role and inline deny of prod ARNs to staging.

kevin: Post-drill extraction (gcloud example):

```
PROJECT=redwood-staging
 gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_key' --project="$PROJECT" --freshness=72h --format=json > /tmp/key-drill-logs.json
 jq -r '.[] | {ts: .timestamp, action: .jsonPayload.action, actor: .jsonPayload.actor_email, sess: .jsonPayload.admin_session_id}' /tmp/key-drill-logs.json
```

maria: After-action: timeline, RBAC diff, log digest, compliance memo for legal, remediation steps if rewrap fails.

ashley: I'll update the runbook: attendees, legal notif, exact IAM policies, audit extraction commands, and postmortem template. Invite going out. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Add monitoring alert to escalate on any rewrap non-2xx. Fail closed and route traffic away if needed.

ashley: Thanks all. See you tomorrow.
